items.title: FedEx (FDX) Raises Demand Surcharges, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
items.summary: FedEx (FDX) just told customers it is raising demand surcharges on many U.S. import and export lanes, a pricing move that directly affects what the parcel giant earns on each shipment. The FedEx share price has eased in recent weeks, with the 30-day share price return down 6.6% and the 90-day move lower by 7.6%. items.summary: FedEx has delivered a strong multi year share price run, which now puts a spotlight on whether the current US$303.65 stock price is backed by the cash the business is expected to generate.
